statement: Define mapval(n) for a nonnegative integer n as follows: write n in decimal without leading zeros, except write 0 as the single digit 0; if the digits from most significant to least significant are d_k,...,d_0, then mapval(n) = sum_{j=0}^{k} mapping[d_j] * 10^j. Whenever the function returns a result r, let L = len(nums); for each integer v, let I_v be the increasing list of indices i with 0 <= i < L and mapval(nums[i]) = v; let V be the increasing list of all v for which I_v is nonempty. Then len(r) = L and r is exactly the concatenation, over v in V, of the lists [nums[i] for i in I_v].
preconditions: len(mapping) = 10; for every i with 0 <= i < 10, 0 <= mapping[i] <= 9; mapping[0],...,mapping[9] are pairwise distinct; let L = len(nums); 1 <= L <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < L, 0 <= nums[i] < 10^9.

statement: Define mapval as in spec_1. Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = len(nums) and every entry of r is an input number; for every integer t, let k be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and mapval(nums[i]) <= t. Then for every p with 0 <= p < k, mapval(r[p]) <= t, and for every p with k <= p < len(r), mapval(r[p]) > t.
